source_span:
We can rewrite $g(x)$ as follows:
$$g(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x+8} = \frac{3x+24}{x+8}-\frac{23}{x+8} = 3 - \frac{23}{x+8}.$$Then we note that $x+8$ takes on all real values, so $\frac{1}{x+8}$ takes on every value which is the reciprocal of some nonzero real number, i.e., $\frac{1}{x+8}$ takes on all nonzero values.
